# GENERATED by make_video_reset_model.py; asynchronous boundary abstraction explicit.
# GENERATED by tools/make_video_cpu.py; predecessor files preserved.
# GENERATED by tools/make_memory_bus_cpu.py; predecessor sources preserved.
# GENERATED by tools/make_memory_access_cpu.py from NET-10 runner.
"""NET-10 joined pin graph CPU regression, optionally with selected delays.

Slow scaled clocks in the delayed scenario are CPU timing stimuli, not real VGA.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from run_rtl import ROOT,BASE,fixtures,program_fixture,run
from make_stack_cpu import transform_bench as stack_fixture
from make_register_cpu import transform_bench as register_fixture
from make_address_cpu import transform_bench as address_fixture
from make_execution_cpu import transform_bench as execution_fixture
from make_x_register_cpu import transform_bench as x_fixture
from run_execution_netlist import prepare_guard
OUT=ROOT/'verification/net14c/cpu'



def frame_capture(timed):
    text=r'''   // Observe the actual registered pixel/capture clock, preserving
   // all samples and the reference PPM despite pipeline/clock division.
   begin:find_frame
     forever begin
       @(posedge memory.capture_clk);
       if(h==0 && v==0)disable find_frame;
     end
   end
   f=$fopen("frame.ppm","wb");$fwrite(f,"P6\n160 480\n255\n");
   for(i=0;i<105000;i=i+1)begin
     p=0;
     if(h<160 && v<480)p=memory.vram_read((v/4)*256+h);
     frame_active=h<160 && v<480;
     #__SAMPLE__;
     if(pixel!==p[7:0])$fatal(1,"VGA pin pixel mismatch raster index=%0d",i);
     if(frame_active)begin
       $fwrite(f,"%c%c%c",((p>>5)&7)*255/7,((p>>2)&7)*255/7,(p&3)*255/3);
       frame_pixels=frame_pixels+1;
     end
     @(posedge memory.capture_clk);
   end
'''
    return text.replace('__SAMPLE__','60' if timed else '0.001')


def fixture(text,timed,refs):
    text=x_fixture(execution_fixture(address_fixture(register_fixture(stack_fixture(text)))))
    group_names={'stack_bank':'sp','bus_bank':'bus','micro_bank':'micro','register_bank':'registers','address_bank':'address','execution_bank':'execution','x_register_bank':'x'}
    def replace(m):
        path=group_names[m[1]]+'/'+m[2]
        if path not in refs:raise ValueError('Unknown fixture component '+path)
        return 'dut.'+refs[path]+(m[3] or '')
    text=re.sub(r'dut\.(stack_bank|bus_bank|micro_bank|register_bank|address_bank|execution_bank|x_register_bank)\.(U\d+)(_[01])?',replace,text)
    text='\n'.join(line for line in text.splitlines() if 'dut.x_bank.nibble' not in line)+'\n'
    if timed:
        # Events and samples retain the same phase relationships with enough
        # settling for the selected delay models; async request snapshots wait
        # 500ns, while CPU-edge samples wait 1000ns, before the next half cycle.
        text=text.replace('always #5 clk','always #5000 clk').replace('always #7 video_clk','always #7000 video_clk')
        text=re.sub(r'\bCPU_HALF=5\b','CPU_HALF=5000',text)
        text=re.sub(r'\bVIDEO_HALF=7\b','VIDEO_HALF=7000',text)
        text=text.replace('#0.002','#1000').replace('#0.003','#1000')
        text=text.replace('#0.001;held_address','#500;held_address')
        text=re.sub(r'#1\b','#1000',text)
        text=text.replace('#0.01;', '#1000;')
        counts='ram_before=memory.ram_writes;vram_before=memory.vram_writes;commits=memory.transactions;'
        # Count side effects from BEFORE reset assertion; the 1us response
        # budget must never hide a late write during reset settling.
        if counts in text:
            text=text.replace('         '+counts+'\n','')
            text=text.replace('         if(power_cut)power_good=0;else reset_n=0;', '         '+counts+'\n         if(power_cut)power_good=0;else reset_n=0;')

        text=text.replace('.USE_HC191(USE_HC191)', '.USE_HC191(USE_HC191),.TIMED(1)')
        text=text.replace(' isa1_cpu dut(', ' isa1_cpu #(.TIMED(1)) dut(')
        text=text.replace('isa1_memory memory(', 'isa1_memory #(.TIMED(1)) memory(')
    # Fixed physical access phases replace the old variable-latency/ACK model.
    text=re.sub(r'memory\.(latency|ack_hold)=[^;]+;', '',text)
    if 'held_state' in text:
        old='{pc,sp,x,a,b,z,c,halted,fault,boot,vb,eb,row}'
        if text.count(old)!=2:raise ValueError('WAIT fixture tuple changed')
        text=text.replace(old,"{pc,sp,x,a,b,z,c,halted,fault,6'b0}")
        # Peripheral effects occur at the physical IO_COMMIT before ACK; CPU
        # architectural registers remain strictly unchanged throughout WAIT.
        monitor="""
 always @(boot or vb or eb or row)if(active && req && reset_n && power_good)
   if(!memory.io_commit)$fatal(1,"MMIO change outside physical commit");
"""
        text=text.replace('endmodule',monitor+'endmodule')
    # Retain original fixture semantics by seeding the component arrays,
    # without wrapper storage or pretending that reset initializes SRAM.
    for old,new in [('ram_tag','frontend.U1.tag'),('vram_tag','frontend.U2.tag'),('rom_tag','frontend.U3.tag'),('ram','frontend.U1.mem'),('vram','frontend.U2.mem'),('eeprom','frontend.U3.mem')]:
        text=text.replace('memory.'+old+'[','memory.'+new+'[')
    if 'module tb_rtl_program;' in text:
        if timed:text=text.replace('isa1_memory #(.TIMED(1)) memory(', 'isa1_memory #(.TIMED(1),.FIXTURE_DEFAULTS(0)) memory(')
        else:text=text.replace('isa1_memory memory(', 'isa1_memory #(.FIXTURE_DEFAULTS(0)) memory(')
    if 'isa1_memory ' in text:
        text=text.replace('$finish;', '$display("MEMORY_MODEL ram_valid_writes=%0d vram_valid_writes=%0d ram_aborts=%0d vram_aborts=%0d fixture_defaults=%0d",memory.ram_writes,memory.vram_writes,memory.ram_aborts,memory.vram_aborts,memory.FIXTURE_DEFAULTS);$display("RESET_BOUNDARY stage1_recovery_events=%0d stage2_recovery_events=%0d binary_resolution_late=1 analog_metastability_approved=0",memory.raster.U8_0.recovery_events,memory.raster.U8_1.recovery_events);$finish;')
    # Preserve the old backend period in zero-delay logical regressions by
    # clocking the four-phase raster at 4x its predecessor stimulus. This is
    # not an operating frequency claim. Delayed runs use 25.175 MHz master.
    text=text.replace('always #7 video_clk','always #1.75 video_clk')
    text=text.replace('always #7000 video_clk','always #19.860973 video_clk')
    text=text.replace('parameter integer USE_HC191=0,CPU_HALF=5,VIDEO_HALF=7;', 'parameter integer USE_HC191=0;parameter realtime CPU_HALF=5,VIDEO_HALF=1.75;')
    text=text.replace('parameter integer USE_HC191=0,CPU_HALF=5000,VIDEO_HALF=7000;', 'parameter integer USE_HC191=0;parameter realtime CPU_HALF=5000,VIDEO_HALF=19.860973;')
    # A stopped divided backend cannot incidentally initialize every state FF
    # by clocking during reset. Supply an actual pulse before the old fixture.
    text=text.replace(' initial begin\n',' initial begin\n   #500;reset_n=1;#500;reset_n=0;\n',1)
    if 'module tb_rtl_program;' in text:
        a=text.index('   // Capture an entire VGA frame')
        b=text.index('   $fclose(f);',a)
        text=text[:a]+frame_capture(timed)+text[b:]
    return text


def main():
    timed='--timed' in sys.argv;quick='--quick' in sys.argv
    target=OUT/('results-timed-async.json' if timed else 'results-ideal-async.json')
    refs=json.loads((ROOT/'hardware/cpu_global/design.json').read_text())['reference_map']
    models=[ROOT/p for p in ['sim/hdl/hc_models.sv','sim/net02/package_models.sv','sim/net03/package_models.sv','sim/net04/package_models.sv','hardware/cpu_global/cpu_global_netlist.sv','hardware/memory_decode/memory_decode_netlist.sv','hardware/memory_bus_access/memory_access_netlist.sv','sim/net13/memory_devices.sv','hardware/memory_bus/memory_bus_netlist.sv','sim/net14c/package_models_async.sv','sim/net14c/video_raster_async_netlist.sv','sim/net14c/isa1_memory_video.sv']]
    benches=['tb_rtl_cpu','tb_rtl_safety','tb_stack_guards','tb_rtl_program']
    source_names=['tools/make_video_reset_model.py','tools/run_video_cpu_async.py','sim/net14b/package_models.sv','hardware/video_raster/video_raster_netlist.sv','tools/make_video_cpu.py','tools/run_video_cpu.py','tools/build_video_raster.py','tools/run_video_raster.py','tools/run_video_raster_checks.py','hardware/video_raster/design.json','hardware/video_raster/package-functions.json','verification/net14b/video_raster.xml','tools/build_cpu_global.py','tools/convert_cpu_global.py','tools/run_cpu_global.py','tools/make_memory_access_cpu.py','tools/run_memory_access_cpu.py','tools/make_memory_bus_cpu.py','tools/run_memory_bus_cpu.py','tools/build_memory_bus.py','tools/prepare_memory_bus_access.py','tools/build_memory_bus_access.py','hardware/memory_bus/design.json','hardware/memory_bus/package-functions.json','verification/net13/memory_bus.xml','hardware/memory_bus_access/design.json','hardware/memory_bus_access/package-functions.json','verification/net13/access/memory_access.xml','tools/build_memory_access.py','hardware/memory_access/design.json','hardware/memory_access/package-functions.json','verification/net12/memory_access.xml','verification/net11/memory_decode.xml','tools/run_rtl.py','tools/make_stack_cpu.py','tools/make_register_cpu.py','tools/make_address_cpu.py','tools/make_execution_cpu.py','tools/make_x_register_cpu.py','tools/run_execution_netlist.py','hardware/cpu_global/design.json','hardware/cpu_global/package-functions.json','verification/net10/cpu_global.xml','firmware/rtl01_diagnostic.asm']
    sources=[*models,*[ROOT/p for p in source_names],*[ROOT/'sim/tests'/(p+'.sv') for p in benches],*[BASE/f'control_lane{i}.bin' for i in range(4)]]
    report={'date':'2026-11-25','iteration':'NET-14C','timed':timed,'quick':quick,'python':platform.python_version(),'iverilog':subprocess.run(['iverilog','-V'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()[0],
      'scope':'CPU + pin-derived memory and NET-14B raster/slot/capture; MMIO remains a model; logical ideal clocks scaled, delayed master 25.175 MHz; unknown unseeded SRAM boot; bounded binary reset resolution at external synchronizer only, no analog metastability/MTBF/PVT/PCB signoff',
      'sources':[{'path':p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sources],'runs':[]}
    def save():target.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='isa1-global-') as tmp:
        work=Path(tmp)
        for lane in range(4):
            data=(BASE/f'control_lane{lane}.bin').read_bytes()
            (work/f'control_lane{lane}.hex').write_text(''.join(f'{b:02x}\n' for b in data))
        rows,report['opcode_cases']=fixtures(quick)
        (work/'vectors.hex').write_text(''.join(''.join(f'{v:08x}\n' for v in row) for row in rows))
        report['program'],frame,png=program_fixture(work)
        for bench in benches:
            text=(ROOT/'sim/tests'/(bench+'.sv')).read_text()
            # prepare_guard expects original control seeds before other adapters.
            if bench=='tb_stack_guards':text=prepare_guard(stack_fixture(text));text=fixture(text,timed,refs)
            else:text=fixture(text,timed,refs)
            (work/(bench+'.sv')).write_text(text)
        configurations=['tb_rtl_cpu','tb_rtl_safety'] if quick else benches
        for bench in configurations:
            command=['iverilog','-g2012','-Wall','-s',bench]
            if bench=='tb_rtl_cpu':command += [f'-P{bench}.CASES={len(rows)}']
            if bench=='tb_rtl_program':command += [f'-P{bench}.RETIREMENTS={report["program"]["retirements"]}',f'-P{bench}.BUS_COUNT={report["program"]["transactions"]}']
            command += ['-o',str(work/'bench.vvp'),*map(str,models),str(work/(bench+'.sv'))]
            row={'bench':bench,'compile':run(command,work)}
            if row['compile']['exit']==0:
                row['execution']=run(['vvp',str(work/'bench.vvp')],work,timeout=1200)
                if bench=='tb_rtl_program' and row['execution']['exit']==0:
                    row['frame_matches_reference']=(work/'frame.ppm').read_bytes()==frame
                    if not row['frame_matches_reference']:row['execution']['exit']=1
                    else:(OUT/('frame-timed.png' if timed else 'frame-ideal.png')).write_bytes(png)
            report['runs'].append(row);save();print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
            if row['compile']['exit'] or row.get('execution',{}).get('exit')!=0:return 1
    return 0


if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
